patch_description: This redesign replaces the monolithic strategy pipeline with a state-centric architecture: a compact bitset board, a reusable route engine, transactional segment expansion, checkpointed suffix evaluation, and simulated annealing over composable segment plans. The routing module handles moves and slides uniformly, while segment generation combines direct travel, target unblocking, stopper-based slides, and post-target board edits. Checkpoints make local-search candidate evaluation re-run only the affected suffix, reducing repeated work and improving search throughput.
